_doc: ledger 0097 round 3: the Full course's 3DEP grid (ledger 0059's full-course build of tracks/high-plains, scripts.elevation.heightfield, 2026-10-28; kept on the Mac outside git until now): the same 40 m stage, west / east / south edges as the West-only grid it replaces (40 x 15, north edge 39.737798), widened north to 39.74124 (the north loop + its 150 m margin). Against the native 3DEP samples beside the north section (source/full/corridor_3dep_north.json, 7,375 samples) it reads -0.08 +- 0.35 m; the grid it replaces -0.21 +- 0.39 m over its part of them.
